record.summary: Defines what claude-observatory observes and where its own artifacts live. The observed universe is ~/.claude (recursive) plus the sibling state file ~/.claude.json, nothing else. Path resolution, the canonical relative-path key, the ignore list, the lstat-based tree walker, and the layout assertion that refuses to run when the project directory sits inside the watch root. Carries the repository's first invariant: the tool is read-only toward the observed universe.
record.title: The observed universe: paths, layout separation, and the walker
